mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO outbound_order (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, allocation_id, attempt_id, owner_id, execution_authorization_id, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{allocationId}, #{attemptId}, #{ownerId}, #{authId}, #{status}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO outbound_package (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, order_id, package_no, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{orderId}, #{packageNo}, #{status}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
